description: Unified orchestrator access-control & pre-payment firewall for autonomous AI agents: enforces per-tx/daily USD spend caps, human-approval threshold, allowlists/denylists, HTTPS/phishing URL check, prompt-injection scan, and secret/PII exfiltration guard, returning an Ed25519-signed ALLOW / HOLD_FOR_HUMAN / DENY attestation verifiable offline via /.well-known/jwks.json. Free interactive tester (10/day): https://apexfaucet.xyz/firewall/ . $0.005 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1) or X-API-Key. agentId.description: Optional caller/agent identifier recorded in signed claims.

human_above_usd.description: Optional autonomous spend threshold above which HOLD_FOR_HUMAN is returned.

payee.description: Optional target wallet address or merchant identifier.

payloadText.description: Optional outbound payload text to scan for secret/key/PII exfiltration.

policy.description: Optional full policy object ({ maxTxUsd, dailyLimitUsd, spentTodayUsd, humanApprovalAboveUsd, allowlist, denylist, allowedActions, allowedChains, allowedTools, minDeliveryScore, ttlSeconds }).

prompt.description: Optional inbound prompt text to scan for injection/hijack.

target.description: Optional full target object ({ amountUsd, payee, url, chain, tool, prompt, payloadText }).

url.description: Optional target URL to check for HTTPS & phishing signals.
